mapper.select: SELECT a.USE_STPLAT_ID, a.USE_STPLAT_NM, a.USE_STPLAT_CN, a.INFO_PROVD_AGRE_CN, TO_CHAR(a.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'YYYYmmdd') FRST_REGIST_PNTTM , a.FRST_REGISTER_ID, TO_CHAR(a.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM,'YYYYmmdd') LAST_UPDT_PNTTM , a.LAST_UPDUSR_ID , (SELECT USER_NM FROM COMVNUSERMASTER WHERE ESNTL_ID = a.FRST_REGISTER_ID) AS FRST_REGISTER_NM FROM NSTPLATINFO a WHERE a.USE_STPLAT_ID=#{useStplatId}

SELECT USE_STPLAT_ID, USE_STPLAT_NM, USE_STPLAT_CN, INFO_PROVD_AGRE_CN, TO_CHAR(FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'YYYYmmdd') FRST_REGIST_PNTTM , FRST_REGISTER_ID, TO_CHAR(LAST_UPDT_PNTTM,'YYYYmmdd') LAST_UPDT_PNTTM , LAST_UPDUSR_ID FROM NSTPLATINFO WHERE 1=1
AND USE_STPLAT_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND USE_STPLAT_CN LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
ORDER BY USE_STPLAT_NM DESC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}

SELECT COUNT(*) totcnt FROM NSTPLATINFO WHERE 1=1
AND USE_STPLAT_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND USE_STPLAT_CN LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NSTPLATINFO (USE_STPLAT_ID , USE_STPLAT_NM , USE_STPLAT_CN , INFO_PROVD_AGRE_CN , FRST_REGIST_PNTTM , FRST_REGISTER_ID , LAST_UPDT_PNTTM , LAST_UPDUSR_ID) VALUES ( #{useStplatId} , #{useStplatNm} , #{useStplatCn} , #{infoProvdAgreCn} , NOW() , #{frstRegisterId} , NOW() , #{lastUpdusrId} )
